CRMLead.title: CRMLead
CRMLead.description: Customer inquiry or lead record captured from website forms or RUBI Assistant chatbot

customerName.description: Full name of the prospective customer

serviceCategory.description: Service category (Software Development, Statutory & Compliance, Citizen E-Services)

requirement.description: Customer project brief or requirement message

source.description: Lead acquisition channel (Website Lead Form, Chatbot, etc.)

status.description: Pipeline status (New, Contacted, Quotation Sent, Work In Progress, Completed, Pending Payments, Converted, etc.)

consentStatus.description: Whether customer agreed to privacy terms and contact consent

bookingAmount.description: Booking amount in INR (e.g. 236 for E-Services)

paymentStatus.description: Payment status for booking or advance

internalNotes.description: Internal team notes on the inquiry

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Authorized administrative user profile and role definition

/crm_leads/{leadId}.description: Customer enquiry records managed by authorized RUBI TECH PARK administrators

/admin_roles/{email}.description: Authorized administrative accounts permitted to access CRM data
